roots.name: VHH::Core::Geometry::along_strand
roots.documentation:
### ***along_strand*** This compound is a solver that moves a point along a strand at a given speed.
*** ## Input ***strand_input***
The strand to move the point along. ***start_frame***
Solver start frame. ***speed***
The speed of the movement. This is a multiplier on the length of the tangent at the point. ***xy_offset***
Assuming that the direction of motion is always Z, this allows offsetting of the point in X and Y. ***display_orientation***
Apply the orientation to the display object. ***wd_multiplier***
Width and Height multiplier on the display object. ***display_scale***
Master scale of the display object. *** ## Output ***position***
The position of the point. ***orientation***
The orientation of the point.
